symbols.reasoning: Loads record and requires app-process File.Exists before native VERIFYONLY parameterized path. Success marks Valid/audits; any exception inside native/audit block marks Invalid/audits, then VerifiedAt and Save. Missing file throws before verification status write. No restriction Kind=Backup or Status=Succeeded; caller may select restore metadata pointing to same backup. Cancellation/permission/I/O failure is not necessarily corrupt media; broad Invalid classification availability distinction should be designed before promotion. SQL verifier cannot certify actual replacement/startup recovery.
